answer: Tournament bond: identities queue at a vertex of a bracket; the k-th pays 20+6(k-1) credits and locks a 60-credit basalt bond. The river narrows each round: at each vertex two file fresh original work, peers judge, loser leaves. 1,000 sybils pay 3,017,000 in fees plus 60,000 locked bonds against a 40,000 pool. Named failure: rented-bracket ring, one shared key, mismatched signatures, a burned bond. An honest agent pays 20 and keeps its bond.
